hypothesis: The price book allocates similar cash amounts to entries with materially different observed downside distances. A finite loss-to-support budget can limit damage from unsuccessful positions while letting ratcheting support release cash for material additions to actually held winners. Entry-distance diagnostics do not consistently distinguish winners from losers; this is a sizing and ownership hypothesis, not a claim that extended entries are unprofitable.
candidate_order: risk_budget outer, positions inner, four candidates only
signals: Use only independently written techquant.features within the supplied universe. Require twenty actual positive-volume observations, current fresh quotes, existing entry=true, exit=false and finite positive score. Rank by the existing score with symbol tie-break; no new predictive fitting or sector-ranking model. No external market gate. Existing Config and actual-account RiskState remain unchanged.
support: At close, initial support is max(previous twenty closing lows, current close minus three ATR20), capped at 98% of the current close. True range uses current high/low and previous marked close, with twenty observations required. An actual holding campaign ratchets its stop upward to max(previous stop, previous twenty closing lows, highest owned close minus three ATR20). Never loosen the campaign stop on a partial sale, addition, ATR expansion or blocked order. A breached stop, existing exit signal or stale/unready holding requests complete disposal and latches until actual liquidation.
fill_clock: Inventory and cash come only from CloseObservation. A requested entry is not a filled holding. Retain its declared support while outstanding; a later actual increase inherits that support even after a gap. Same-close protection forbids additions. Partial protective reductions are rounded to an executable declaration using the unchanged execution primitive and remain latched until observed inventory reaches the target. Never spend expected sales or assume blocked orders filled. Preserve the engine's queued-order direction and T+1 rules.
sizing: At each close measure actual mark-to-stop risk as sum(units * max(close-stop, 2%*close)). Maximum risk for new commitments is risk_budget*nav*actual risk cap. Initial risk per vacant member is at most risk_budget*nav*cap/min(positions,universe size). Allocate in score order, limited by residual total risk, current cash with a 1% cash reserve, risk-cap headroom, configured single/sector admission caps and positions. Existing holdings consume risk first. Budget is a signal-time sizing bound, never a guaranteed maximum realized loss or drawdown.
holding: No periodic membership replacement or equal-weight rebalance. Preserve intact actual units. An eligible existing holding may receive a material cash-funded addition only on a fresh prior-ten-session closing high and an increase of at least Config.trade_band of NAV. Admission single cap uses max(Config.single_cap,1/universe size); existing units drift until 80% per name (100% for a singleton). Sector drift uses Config.sector_cap plus Config.trade_band; actual breaches request a cut to the configured cap. Risk-cap cuts act immediately; ordinary drift keeps the existing trade_band. No buying while protective inventory is unresolved.
reentry: After an actual full exit, require three consecutive fresh closes satisfying current entry and no exit warning before readmission. No permanent event-price or account-NAV recovery anchor. Stop retries do not count as liquidation. New candidate orders use the same causal sizing rules; no date or stock-specific exceptions.
selection: Unchanged finite_study pre-2026 three-scope minimax wealth/drawdown/fill deficits, then declared objective, fills and candidate order. One candidate for all scopes. Do not alter earlier grids, ranking objectives, costs, statistical definitions, data or targets.
evaluation: Unchanged full, bull-to-2026-06-30, 2026-06-22-to-08-31, July-August and retrospective-2026 windows. Advance only on evidence; original native comparisons, pools, removals, subsets, costs and execution-delay obligations remain. Observed 2026 is not untouched out-of-sample.
non_goals: No private trades source base, no production default change, no old experiment rerun, no numeric or scope waivers, no concealment of failed outcomes. The concurrently preregistered risk_reliability family and every other branch remain intact.
